description.value:
Not everyone who answers a higher calling is content to study scripture in a stuffy temple. You chose the path of the holy warrior and joined the Order of the Gauntlet. As a knight of the Gauntlet, you hold the forces of evil in righteous contempt, stand loyally by your siblings in arms, and show deep compassion to the survivors of war. Weapon and holy symbol in hand, you have sworn not to rest until the light of justice has driven the shadow of chaos from Faerûn.

Ability Scores: Strength, Intelligence, Wisdom

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.ZiERNmyyYHjIF2pG]{Tyro of the Gauntlet}

Skill Proficiencies: Athletics and Medicine

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulSmithsTool]{Smith's Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepSpear00000]{Spear}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulSmithsTool]{Smith's Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagLanternBull]{Bullseye Lantern}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHolySymbolV]{Holy Symbol}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagManacles000]{Manacles}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Oil} (5 flasks), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Tinderbox}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav]{Traveler's Clothes}, 9 GP; or (B) 50 GP
